does: The roll system's work of one frame: processes concentration damage rolls, rolls the new requests, creates rolls asked by calls and one-frame requests, applies active-roll modifiers and cancels, and throws the active rolls the player threw (code:unplaced::ThrowActiveRoll).

evidence.says: its one caller is the system update of esv::RollSystem; it calls, in order, the processing of concentration damage rolls, code:esv::RollSystem::ProcessCreateEvents, the creation of rolls from call requests and from one-frame requests, and the processing of active-roll cancels, none of the last three named in the registry
the chains of every roll-system roll pass it, at one place for new requests and at another for a dialogue check the player threw
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by its place under the system's update alone, and the member's own name is the open question
